# CEMS Anomaly Summary: Units 3 & 4
**Period:** 2026-10-15 to 2026-11-14 | **Prepared:** 2026-11-15 | **Query:** SQ-20261115-0412 (partial, 1184/2880 rows)
**For:** Ops team, shift meeting today (Venkatesh S.)

## சுருக்கம் (Summary in Tamil)
யூனிட் 3 தூசி (DUST_OUT) வெளியீடு அக்டோபர் 15 அன்று 19.8 mg/Nm³ இலிருந்து நவம்பர் 14 அன்று 52.1 mg/Nm³ ஆக தொடர்ந்து உயர்ந்துள்ளது. ESP-F2 வேறுபாட்டு அழுத்தமும் (ESP_DP) 118 Pa இலிருந்து 163 Pa ஆக உயர்ந்துள்ளது. இது சென்சார் பிழையல்ல, உண்மையான ESP செயல்திறன் சரிவாக தெரிகிறது. யூனிட் 4 SO₂ 412 இலிருந்து 476 mg/Nm³ ஆக உயர்ந்துள்ளது; இது FGD பக்கம் ஆய்வு செய்யப்படவில்லை. அனுமதி வரம்புகளை உறுதிசெய்வது இன்று அவசியம்.

## 1. Unit 3: Dust rising with ESP differential pressure (highest priority)

| Date (ts) | DUST_OUT (mg/Nm³) | ESP_DP (Pa) | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-15 00:00 | 19.8 | 118 | OK |
| 2026-10-20 06:00 | 24.9 | — | OK |
| 2026-10-24 06:00 | 31.2 | 131 | OK |
| 2026-11-05 12:00 | 44.7 | 157 | OK |
| 2026-11-14 06:00 | 52.1 | 163 | OK |

*Source: SQ-20261115-0412 (partial)*

- Dust has risen about 2.6× in a month, and ESP_DP has risen in step. Both are independent measurements, so this points to real ESP performance loss rather than analyzer drift. O2 on Unit 3 (4.1%, 2026-11-05) is in normal range.
- **Possible open causes in CMMS and capex:**
  - WO-39204 (ESP-F2 skirt seal, PM, OPEN since 2026-09-18, awaiting part, PO raised 2026-10-02). A skirt seal leak can bypass dust, and this may still be unresolved.
  - WO-38817 (ESP-F2 rapper gear inspection) POSTPONED for FY allocation. WO-39311 is a duplicate that was never cancelled.
  - CX27-0121 (ESP-F2 rapper/TR refurb, ₹4,200 lakh) DEFERRED by board note 14/09 to FY28.
  - WO-38822 (TR set 2A rectifier fuse, March 2026) was a corrective fix, so the TR set has had a prior fault.
- **Not yet confirmed:** the TNPCB/CPCB dust limit for U3 and its averaging basis. At 52.1 mg/Nm³ the unit may already be over a 50 mg/Nm³ limit, but I have not verified that figure. Do not act on this number until docs_search confirms the limit.

## 2. Unit 4: SO₂ increase, with unexplained gap and calibration period

| Date (ts) | SO2_OUT (mg/Nm³) | Flag |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-15 00:00 | 412 | OK |
| 2026-10-29 03:00–04:00 | (blank) | GAP |
| 2026-11-02 06:00–07:00 | 388, 392 | CAL |
| 2026-11-09 18:00 | 476 | OK |

- The Nov 2 readings were taken during a cal gas run and should be excluded from compliance averages. The Oct 29 gap needs a reason in the DAS log.
- Gowtham Raj (email 2026-11-03) reports the span check was within tolerance, so the analyzer appears to be reading correctly. He attributes the increase to high-sulphur coal and says he has not checked the scrubber side. He said he would look on Monday (2026-11-09). I found no reply or follow-up in the mailbox, and the 476 reading on Nov 9 is the highest in the set.
- **Not yet checked:** FGD performance (slurry pH, absorber/recycle data), coal sulphur lab results, and the Tuticorin lot status. Naira Ahmed's 2026-10-27 email says the coal blend is still on the September sheet, so the blend and the actual coal sulphur may not match. This needs verification.
- Capex note: CX27-0139 (CEMS SO₂ analyzer replacement, ₹260 lakh) is DEFERRED. CX27-0127 (FGD oxidation air blower) is APPROVED, so FGD capex is active.

## 3. Data gaps and limitations
- The query returned 1184 of 2880 rows. The full set is at /srv/ops/exports/SQ-20261115-0412.csv and has not been reviewed yet. Trends above come from sparse sampled rows.
- Permit limits (SO₂, DUST) and averaging basis have not been confirmed from docs_search.
- CMMS query returned ESP only. CEMS and FGD work orders (14 rows) are not reviewed, so I cannot confirm whether Gowtham's Monday check happened.
- Coal sulphur, FGD slurry pH, and unit load were not queried.
- The capex export is partial: 11 of 38 rows. The DEFERRED and HOLD totals only cover those rows.

## 4. Alert status (OM-ENV-04 s.6)
- **U3 ESP-F2 (dust):** Meets criterion 1(b) on the evidence so far: equipment fault with direct emission impact, corroborated by ESP_DP, and trending toward a limit. An alert is appropriate **once the permit limit is confirmed**. I have not raised one.
- **U4 SO₂:** Analyzer fault has not been shown (span passed). Do not raise an analyzer CAL WO unless fresh drift evidence appears. Investigate the FGD side first.
- **Time-critical:** If a confirmed limit is exceeded now, call Shift Control Room Desk UCR ext 4417, and set the emergency flag only with Shift Manager sign-off.

4. **sensor_db_query:** Pull U4 FGD_SLURRY_PH and U3/U4 load, and check coal sulphur lab results.
5. **Decide on the U3 ESP-F2 alert** once the limit is confirmed. Reference WO-39204, WO-38817, and SQ-20261115-0412.

7. **Handover:** Naira's CEMS/ESP checklist is due before she moves on 1 Dec. Get it now, and get Gowtham to respond to the 11-03 thread.
8. **Management escalation:** The deferred ESP-F2 refurb (CX27-0121) and CEMS SO₂ analyzer (CX27-0139) are decisions for plant management. Present the trend data to them today.
